zh.构建者: 我擅长从模糊的想法出发，边拆解、边尝试、边验证，直至完成
zh.设计师: 我习惯把复杂的问题重新组织，在信息、技术、空间、美学与人之间寻找更合适的关系
zh.建筑设计: 通过几年的学习实践，我逐渐养成了从关系和系统出发去理解和拆解复杂问题的习惯，也培养了我的审美和感受现实的能力。
zh.AIGC: 从文字到图片再到视频，探索AI会怎样改变创作和表达的方式。
zh.交互设计: 从静态图纸到动态交互，探索如何从纯视觉导向到全流程体验的升级
zh.互联网: 从旁观者到创作者，持续学习与输出，并参与到web3的探索，构建自己的赛博足迹
zh.AI 协作: 我把 AI 看作得力的助手和伙伴，而不只是工具。我们一起学习、探索，激发灵感，再把灵感逐步付诸实践。
zh.变成现实: 可能是一段代码、一个网站、一套工作流、一支影像，也可能只是一个足够验证想法的小原型
zh.生活、思考、项目与实践: 生活中的见闻、思考的过程，以及动手做过的项目与尝试，都收集在这里；有些已经成型，有些还在探索中
zh.独立探索: 没有客户，也没有预先写好的任务书，很多时候只是因为一个问题让我足够好奇，想亲自试一试
zh.协作完成: 不同的经验和视角碰在一起，也常常会让一个原本简单的想法长出新的可能
zh.与更多人建联: 不同人的经历和视角，常常能启发我独自思考时忽略的东西。
zh.旅行和摄影: 感受不同场域的能量，记录时间。

en.builder: I am good at starting with a fuzzy idea, breaking it down, experimenting, and testing until it is complete
en.designer: I tend to reorganize complex problems, looking for better relationships between information, technology, space, aesthetics, and people
en.architectural design: Through several years of study and practice, I gradually developed the habit of understanding and breaking down complex problems through relationships and systems, while cultivating my aesthetic judgment and sensitivity to the world around me.
en.AIGC: From text to images to video, exploring how AI will change the way we create and express ourselves.
en.interaction design: From static drawings to dynamic interactions, exploring the shift from a purely visual focus to designing the entire experience
en.the internet: From observer to creator, continually learning and sharing, exploring Web3, and building my own digital footprint
en.working with AI: I see AI as a capable assistant and partner, not just a tool. We learn and explore together, spark ideas, and gradually put them into practice.
en.bring them to life: It might be a piece of code, a website, a workflow, a film, or simply a small prototype that is enough to test an idea
en.life, thoughts, projects, and practice: Observations from everyday life, ideas I have thought through, and projects and experiments I have worked on are collected here; some have taken shape, while others are still being explored
en.independent exploration: No client and no ready-made brief; often, a question simply makes me curious enough to want to try it firsthand
en.made with collaborators: When different experiences and perspectives meet, even a simple idea can develop new possibilities
en.connect with more people: Other people's experiences and perspectives often spark insights into things I overlook when thinking on my own.
en.travel and photography: Feeling the energy of different places, recording time.
